sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Airmail is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, friend! You know how even small changes affect our isolated Tarkov world. Take, for example, the arrival of the humanitarian aid that's being dropped from airplanes. Even I couldn't get some of the components for my work before. But now you can find real treasures in these crates! By the way, I'd like to arrange for a new package. To do this, I need to make sure that the pilots work as instructed, give a drop right after the launch of the red flare. Can you help me with that?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Launch a red signal flare at the old sawmill on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +14,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.01
- 42,000 Roubles
  - 44,100 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 48,300 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser
- 2× Zenit Klesch-2IKS IR illuminator with laser
"It worked, right? Thanks, friend. Our airmail comes in so handy!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red) | 1 | Required | N/A | Must be fired into the sky at the old sawmill. |
| ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol | 1 | Required | N/A | Used to fire the flare cartridge. |
| 26x75mm flare cartridge (Red) | 1 | Required | N/A | Must be fired into the sky at the old sawmill. |
In this quest you have to shoot a red flare into the sky while being in the center of the old sawmill in the east of Woods. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 red flare provided by Mechanic via in-game mail or a 26x75mm red flare cartridge which can be bought at Ref LL3, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 red flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The quest dialogue is referencing the unannounced implementation, and surprise activation of airdrops on December 30, 2021.
